directories.why: Dependencies of the extension itself, fully described by the committed package-lock.json. Nothing here is authored in this repository and nothing is loaded by the browser.
Dependencies of the marketing/docs site, which keeps its own package.json and package-lock.json under website/. Same reasoning as the root tree, and independent of it.
Vitest V8 coverage report. A read-only artefact of the last test run, regenerated by re-running the suite, and never read by the extension.
